title: Agents
line: Write project instructions from the files in the repository.

beats.caption: You start the project setup with `/agents`.
The agent checks the manifest and README.
beats.label: pi-agents

beats.caption: It writes the project’s test command into `AGENTS.md`.

takeaway.title: Base the guide on the project
takeaway.line: Use the commands and paths the repository actually has.

title.text: A new agent can get started faster when the project tells it how to run the checks.

scene.text: Slash agents starts a setup task in the active session. The agent reads the manifest and README, then writes the test command and entry points into the project guide.

takeaway.text: Review the instructions with the repository in view. They should match how this project is actually built and tested.
